routes.mountStatus: Source-declared lazy route inside SafeRoute; actual mounted reachability unverified.

purpose: An authenticated share-card studio for inspecting selected-window drive evidence and composing a privacy-restricted, locally generated SVG.
primaryGoal: Choose an existing card theme, inspect the exact six-line evidence payload and its limitations, and download an SVG without uploading or creating a public share.

dataSources.name: Selected-window drive rows
dataSources.behavior: One capped request, enabled only for a selected vehicle; query key includes scope, signal is forwarded, safeArray selects rows, FAST stale time is retained. Endpoint registration is confirmed, not server filtering or response fidelity.
dataSources.backendEvidenceLimit: Handler, repository, database, authentication enforcement and runtime HTTP behavior were not inspected or exercised.

dataSources.name: Workspace scope and display preferences
dataSources.behavior: Consumes header-owned vehicle/range, vehicle timezone and persisted unit/locale/precision mechanisms. Range persistKey is share-card.range. No duplicate selector is rendered. Owner internals and any preference endpoints were not traced.

dataSources.name: Pure client evidence analysis and local SVG
dataSources.behavior: Derived from returned rows, never a new backend aggregate. SI values remain raw; conversion occurs in display/export. Fixed themes, XML escaping and local Blob/object-URL download; no upload/share mutation is present in inspected page-specific code.

components.contract: Reuse existing category exports. PageLayout forwards PageContainer props and maintains w-full/min-w-0 container. LayoutCard owns title/description/actions/footer/surface. ChartCard forwards canonical chart sizing, toolbar, accessible data columns and exports. SourceContent supports ready/loading/error/empty/retained with custom bodies and recovery.
Keep localized names, disabled/pressed state, table semantics, typography roles and theme tokens. Table.variant=embedded is already available inside a host card.

ShareCardBrief adapts raw metrics through useOperationalMetrics with explicit scope/provenance/status. DataTable owns directory behavior and stable tableId; existing mobilePresentation is opt-in, whereas mobileColumns alone hides cells. Keep source-specific empty and recovery copy.

Category imports are already used. Retain monthly/weekday legend identities, null gaps, accessible tables and raw-SI export rows. FadeIn delegates reduced-motion preference, ignores delay when reduced, and uses initial=false.
Keep feature-specific calculations, privacy and evidence scope outside generic presentation owners. Reuse the existing common state body and display bridge rather than establishing parallel engines.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Distance and duration distributions repeat band mapping, raw export rows, ChartCard, count axes, tooltip and empty-state structure; only thresholds, SI sums and labels differ.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consider a typed feature-local distribution renderer only if both existing behaviors and export identities can be preserved; retain semantic distance/duration wrappers. No new shared chart system.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Six localized line labels are independently declared in the inventory and composition hook.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse a feature-local label contract while retaining the six stable line keys, translations and order.

responsive.sourceStrategy: Two grids stack at default width and become 3/2 columns at xl; preview image is w-full and capped at 800px. Accounting items switch to two columns at lg. Tables have bounded internal horizontal overflow.

issues.detail: mobileColumns keeps rank/day/distance only. Duration, energy, efficiency and route-withholding status receive hidden md:table-cell in the current DataTable path; this caller supplies neither mobilePresentation nor an expanded detail path.
issues.fix: Adopt the existing typed mobilePresentation/details contract or preserve all columns with reachable bounded overflow. Retain every metric and privacy indication, current tableId, ordering and row identity.

responsive.verification: All ten contract widths, allocated-container widths, 200% text, long localized labels and RTL are unverified. Dual chart axes and fixed heights warrant viewport QA; clipping or zero-height charts are not asserted.

sourceStrengths: All 14 section roots have localized aria-labels.
Theme Select has an accessible name; swatch buttons expose aria-pressed and h-11/w-11 targets.
Tables use row-header scopes; charts supply descriptions and dataColumns.
SVG has title/desc and image role; DOM preview has a localized alt and adjacent disclosure, and the separate line inventory exposes six values.
FadeIn has explicit reduced-motion handling in its shared implementation.

issues.detail: Standalone SVG accessible title/description contains title, subtitle and scope disclosure, but not the six metric labels/values. The application has a separate accessible inventory; the exported artifact cannot rely on that DOM.
issues.fix: Extend the escaped SVG description with all six label/value pairs and missing-value context without exposing private source fields or changing the visual metric payload.

accessibility.verification: Keyboard, focus order/restoration, screen reader behavior, effective contrast, forced colors, touch reachability and actual reduced-motion rendering were not exercised.

implemented.name: No selected vehicle / unresolved prerequisite
implemented.behavior: Passive explanatory body; source shells remain present.

implemented.name: Initial loading / network paused
implemented.behavior: Skeleton/status during fetch; paused copy does not infer an empty API result.

implemented.name: Fatal initial failure
implemented.behavior: Localized message and Retry evidence query action.

implemented.name: Missing individual measurements
implemented.behavior: Em dashes, missing badges and support counts; no measured-zero substitution.

implemented.name: Retained refresh failure / paused / refreshing
implemented.behavior: Cached content remains; opt-in alerts in evidence/source ledgers. Brief communicates cached/paused/refreshing status.

implemented.name: Export unavailable
implemented.behavior: Download disabled without svg; preview explains lack of eligible evidence and offers Browse drives.

issues.detail: Endpoint badge is success/Resolved unless cachedRefreshError exists. Retained paused or actively refreshing evidence can therefore show a success badge beside the separate paused/refreshing alert.
issues.fix: Derive localized badge text/tone from the existing paused/refreshing/error state contract; retain resolved-data semantics and do not infer offline merely from historical timestamps.

states.verification: These are inspected source branches, not executed cases. No explicit source-age stale threshold or last-success timestamp is provided by ShareCardQueryState; historical drive timestamps are correctly not described as query freshness.

visualIssues.detail: Four chart sections hardcode electric cyan, amber and purple constants instead of consuming the existing central chart palette/preference mechanism.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing palette owner for analytical charts with stable series assignments and adequate contrast; preserve deliberate saved neon choices rather than resetting them. No new color registry.

visualIssues.detail: Selected swatch uses a fixed cyan border independent of the semantic selection token and chosen export theme.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing semantic focus/selection styling while retaining theme IDs, pressed state and deliberate swatch colors.

visualIssues.detail: Fixed export themes include bright cyan/green/orange accents, accent outline/rule and translucent decorative circles. This is a self-contained SVG palette, not theme-aware application styling. No glow filter, pure #ffffff text, or animated glow was found in this inspected renderer; title #f8fafc is soft off-white.
visualIssues.fix: Review export visual intensity separately from app chrome. Preserve midnight/aurora/ember choices and deterministic 800x418 behavior; any approved restraint must keep all lines/disclosures and cannot silently reset selected theme behavior.

visualIssues.detail: Six semantic Table callsites default to standalone framed chrome inside existing cards; accounting renders one framed Table per identity inside another bordered list tile. This adds repeated borders/surfaces rather than hierarchy.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing Table.variant=embedded where host cards/tiles already own surfaces, preserving row labels, all identity values and overflow behavior.

architectureIssues.detail: Window rejection is conditional on validWindow; invalid instants disable both boundary checks, while readiness depends only on eligible row count. Analysis exposes window.valid/timezoneValid but composition does not gate or disclose those flags. This is a conditional source risk, not proof the mounted range hook supplies invalid input.
architectureIssues.fix: Resolve invalid-window/fallback-timezone handling with the existing range/data-trust owner; display a clear source limitation and prevent claiming validated selected-window exports when bounds are invalid. Preserve all valid-range calculations and distinguish a source failure from measured empty.

architectureIssues.detail: Residual/tolerance use the general display.formatNumber default precision. At low saved precision, the explicit 0.000001 tolerance can render as zero, hiding the specialist audit threshold even though pass/fail uses the raw value.
architectureIssues.fix: Use explicit sufficient precision or a source-preserving specialist representation for residual/tolerance only, retaining locale and general saved precision elsewhere.

priority.level: P1 preservation and trust, then P2 visual consistency
order: Make mobile directory details reachable without losing columns
Preserve standalone SVG accessible metric payload
Correct paused/refreshing badge semantics and specialist precision
Adopt existing palette and embedded table contracts
priority.rationale: The page already has substantial decomposition and source states. Modernization should not flatten its evidence, scope/privacy explanations, actions or specialized exports.

competingImplementations.detail: Local analytical chart palettes compete with web\src\lib\colors.ts and its existing palette hooks.
competingImplementations.fix: Adopt existing shared palette contracts; no shared implementation change is established by this audit.

competingImplementations.detail: Feature-specific fatal-error and cached-alert presentation sits alongside SourceContent's existing error/retained recovery APIs. Specialist no-vehicle/paused language is legitimate and must not be removed.
competingImplementations.fix: Consider composing existing errorRecovery/retainedMessage props only if source-specific wording, independent panels and retry behavior stay intact; no replacement state system.

preservation.countScope: share-card dependency count includes production .ts/.tsx barrel/types/hooks but excludes test; presentation total is page + all production share-card TSX + ShareCardBrief. shareCard.ts is an additional 1033 lines.

actions.name: Header copyLink
actions.behavior: Existing PageLayout forwarded capability; actual clipboard/link implementation not traced or invoked.

actions.name: Select theme and three swatch buttons
actions.behavior: Keep midnight initial theme and midnight/aurora/ember keys; changes are component-local, not persisted.

actions.name: Download safe SVG
actions.behavior: Local Blob/download anchor with sanitized dated filename and 1500ms object-URL cleanup. Never upload.

actions.name: Retry evidence query
actions.behavior: Refetch existing query, not a new data source.

actions.name: Chart toolbar/data alternatives/export and series toggles
actions.behavior: Keep four canonical ChartCard toolbars and source export payloads; keep monthly/weekday hiddenSeries keys and chartKey preferences. Shared runtime controls were not exercised.

actions.name: Directory table behavior
actions.behavior: Keep existing DataTable pipeline, keyExtractor=id, tableId=share-card:representative-drives, compact density and pagination=false.

dataBehavior: One capped returned sample, never all-history/full-range/lifetime certification; reaching 1000 rows changes disclosures and monthly missing-month semantics.
Positive integer identity, first-seen duplicate handling, parseable timestamp and valid half-open [start,end) checks; keep all seven terminal dispositions.
Preserve finite nonnegative measured zero, nullable unknowns, independent field support and signed valid temperature handling.
Distance-weighted energy uses positive-distance paired rows; regen percentage uses energy+regen paired denominator. Do not replace with averages of ratios.
Calendar buckets use resolved vehicle timezone; invalid timezone currently falls back to UTC and exposes timezoneValid.

Representative ranking ties use duration, timestamp and ID; no exact address text, coordinates, geometry, VIN or location reaches the card/directory presentation. Raw API rows still arrive in the query: presentation redaction is not network redaction.
All six SVG slots survive, including missing em dashes and missing disclosure; deterministic escaped 800x418 SVG with title/subtitle/footer and cap caveats.
Display helpers retain saved units, number precision and locale; chart/table export fields remain meters/seconds/Wh rather than formatted display strings.
Retain cached data on refresh failure/paused fetching; no fabricated data or backend capability.
